title: Fix Sketchpad Toolbar Slot Width For Settings Band
description: Layout toolbar slot needed explicit full width so sketchpad absolute settings zone (Filter/Create) resolves percentage positioning correctly; sketchpad toolbar root uses w-full max-w-full; calc edges use valid Tailwind arbitrary syntax.
summary: Resolved Filter/Create toolbar controls collapsing to a sliver: Layout toolbar slot is now a full-width strip (left-0 right-0, flex justify-center, pointer-events-none) so the sketchpad toolbar has a real containing block width; sketchpad toolbar root uses w-full max-w-full. Edge positioning uses right-[calc(50%_+_4px)] and left-[calc(50%_+_4px)] for valid CSS in Tailwind. Verified: npx tsc --noEmit --project compose/sketchpad/tsconfig.json and npm test --workspace elements/ui pass.
